messages:
Alex: Quick check — planning to enable canary toggle for model v4 (v4-opt) in NA + EU.
Alex: Start: 5% global split for 1h, then 10% for 2h, 20% steady. Region split: NA 70% of canary, EU 30%.
Priya: thumbs up — do we have the SLOs/alerts wired for this? specifically 5xx rate and latency p90
Morgan: I wired a MetricAlert: `model.v4.5xx_rate` and `model.v4.latency_p90` to pager if >0.5% or p90 > 1200ms
Devon: Also added traffic-safe fallback to v3 via routing policy `fallback:model=v3` if errors spike
Alex: Deploy bot created the flag: `ffctl create --name canary.v4 --env prod --meta "regions=na,eu;percent=5"`
Alex: Flag will be updated by schedule script: 
```
# ramp plan
sleep 3600 && ffctl set canary.v4 --percent 10
sleep 7200 && ffctl set canary.v4 --percent 20
```
Priya: Small ask — enable KV cache warmup for v4 in NA before ramp to reduce cold-token latency (Devon can you confirm?)
Devon: Confirmed. Pre-warm job queued to run 30m before start in NA.
Priya: Also can we gate EU ramp on error budget remaining > 80%? otherwise keep EU at 5%
Morgan: I added a check in the ramp script: if `error_budget_eu < 0.8` then skip increase and notify #eng-oncall
oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation for the window: Morgan (primary), Priya (backup)
Alex: If anything spikes >0.5% 5xx for 10m — rollback plan: `ffctl set canary.v4 --percent 0` and open incident
Devon: I'll keep a short runbook entry in the thread: rollback command + logs to capture
Devon: Runbook snippet:
```
1) ffctl set canary.v4 --percent 0
2) collect logs: k9s -n inference logs -l model=v4 --since=15m > /tmp/v4-errs.log
3) notify infra + ml-eval
```
Priya: tagging @eng-oncall and @ml-team for visibility :eyes:
Alex: OK — proceeding with schedule. Will post start confirmation 10m before. :rocket:
deploy-bot: feature flag "canary.v4" created by Alex in prod (id: ff-67821)
